items.title: Webinar: Revolutionizing Genomic Sample Prep with Volta and IDT
items.summary: Watch this on-demand webinar presented by Abdul Mohammed, Head of Applications Development at Volta Labs, and Nick Downey, NGS Collaborations Lead at IDT. They discuss performance data from Volta's IDT xGen™ NGS Hybridization Capture app on the Callisto Sample Prep System and how Callisto addresses existing challenges to offer an innovative and reliable solution for automating hyb capture workflows.

items.title: Webinar: Scaling PacBio sequencing with automated library prep
items.summary: Watch this on-demand webinar hosted by Genomeweb, featuring speakers from Mount Sinai and PacBio. Learn how to scale PacBio sequencing with automated library prep on the Callisto Sample Prep System.

items.title: AMP 2025 Recap: A Transformative Week for NGS Prep and the Callisto Platform
items.summary: AMP 2025 was an unforgettable week for the Volta Labs team. It was a week of meaningful conversations, major milestones, and an inspiring reminder of why we’re building the future of automated NGS prep.

items.title: Automating the Last Mile of Targeted Sequencing Workflows on Callisto
items.summary: Optimize your targeted sequencing with Volta Labs automation. The Callisto platform simplifies sample prep, reducing costs & time from DNA to library.

items.title: Volta Labs and Hartwig Medical Foundation Collaborate to Advance Oncological Discoveries with the Callisto™ Sample Prep System
Volta Labs Launches Access Program to Support Academic Researchers Amid Budget Cuts
items.summary: Academic research institutions are facing tightening capital budgets and funding uncertainty. At a time when academic researchers are being asked to do more with less, Volta is keeping Callisto accessible by launching the Volta Access Program; a new initiative aimed at increasing access to its Callisto™ Sample Prep System for academic research institutions in the U.S. facing tightening capital budgets. Selected applicants will be able to access Callisto for $4,950 per month over a 24-month term, with full service support and no consumables minimum — helping labs stay productive even as financial caution shapes decision-making across the academic community.

items.title: Volta Labs at AACR 2025: Showcasing Advanced Targeted Sequencing Solutions for Cancer Research
items.summary: The Volta Labs team is excited to announce our participation in the American Association of Cancer Research (AACR) Annual Meeting 2025, taking place April 25-30 in Chicago, Illinois. As the critical driver of progress against cancer, AACR brings together scientists, clinicians, and healthcare professionals to share groundbreaking advancements in cancer science and medicine.
